notes: The same live server, five loaded maps, observer position, runtime stair, blur setting, positioning overlay, and viewport dimensions were retained for the paired stair captures.
The capture sampler is opt-in, uses preallocated per-frame storage, and allocates its percentile scratch arrays only after the sample window ends.

change.projectedLighting: Replace the result-materializing physics ray overload with a CMU-owned first-hit query over the current frame's physics broadphases. The predicate preserves the existing map, maximum distance, ignored source entity, opaque collision-layer, and hard-fixture rules.
change.currentOpening: Use the allocation-free occluder first-hit query with the previous endpoint-touching behavior for current-view opening visibility.
change.stairPreview: Use the allocation-free occluder first-hit query with the previous endpoint-touching behavior for stair-preview sprite and tile visibility.
change.blur: No production blur composition behavior changed. Opt-in pass/draw instrumentation was added because consolidating per-depth blur passes would change accumulated blur strength.

rejectedOccluderSubstitution.conclusion: Rejected because the generic occluder query is not behavior-equivalent to the existing physics broadphase decision.

acceptedBroadphaseFirstHit.conclusion: Accepted after every comparison matched the existing physics result.

blurCharacterization.conclusion: Blur is measurable in the one-lower-pass scene, but no shader/copy-specific GPU timestamp was available and consolidating sequential depth passes would change the image. No behavior change is justified.

validation.releaseClientBuild: Passed with zero warnings and zero errors.

deferredRisks: The stair scene exercised 349 sprite candidates and LOS checks per frame but no nonempty FOV-mask tiles; tile-heavy stair preview still needs a representative visual capture.
The capture records client CPU/frame distributions and work counts. It does not provide isolated GPU copy or shader timestamps.
Multi-depth blur can issue more than one sequential pass. Consolidation or downsampling is deferred because it would change accumulated blur strength without a visual contract.
Projected lights still do not cast receiving-map shadows; this legacy visual approximation remains MZ-061 rather than being changed during a performance pass.
The exact broadphase comparator covered 374,400 decisions in the Bush scene, not every possible rotated or moving-grid topology.
